sequences.name: Apothecary
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Relatively resistant to poisonous elements and toxins.
Spirituality: Enhanced Spirituality.
Spirit Vision: Shows a person's overall health and wellbeing.
Medicinal Concoction: Excels at creating and mixing herbs and dead animal parts to create Medicinal Concoctions.
Taming: Good at Taming and domesticating plants.

sequences.name: Beast Tamer
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Greatly improved physical attributes; can fight wild beasts head-on.
Animal Senses: Can read thoughts of, utilize senses of, communicate to, and control Animals.
Taming: Can Tame, domesticate, and use various unique animals; includes Beyonder and supernatural creatures.

sequences.name: Vampire
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Superhuman agility, speed, and regeneration; lifespan increases to ~300 years.
Wings of Darkness: Can form illusory bat wings for speed boost and limited flight.
Corrosive Claw: Nails can cut through steel with strong corrosion properties.
Abyss Shackles: Can condense Darkness or Shadows into illusory shackles to restrict enemies.
The Embrace: Can bestow excess Beyonder Characteristics to turn humans into vampires.
Blood Servant Conversion: Can Convert any living creature into a Blood Servant.

sequences.name: Potions Professor
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Terrifying speed, agility, balance, and coordination; enhanced hearing and sense of smell.
Discerning Spiritual Materials: Vast knowledge on discerning spiritual materials for concoctions.
Potion & Perfume Crafting: Can mix and create Potions and Perfumes with extraordinary effects.

sequences.name: Scarlet Scholar
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Terrifying speed and unimaginable regeneration; can create afterimages.
Full Moon: Creates environments advantageous for themselves through control of Moonlight.
Moonlight Transformation: Can transform into condensed Moonlight to move and reform.
Flash: Can Teleport to another location within Moonlit areas.
Potion & Perfume Crafting: Enhanced effectiveness of Potions and Perfumes.
Natural resistance to Nightmare-related influences.

sequences.name: Shaman King
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Strong physique, ridiculous speed, powerful regeneration; lifespan increases to ~1000 years.
Nature Interaction: Can borrow the Moon's power on the spot without Ritualistic Magic.
Moon Paper Figurine: Can transform Moonlight into a Paper Figurine for Substitution.
Gaze of Darkness: Forms a Substitution connection to manifest eye state onto target.
Illusory Bats: Can divide into a swarm of vampire bats to reconstruct from.
Howl: Can cause enemies' blood to frost up, delaying senses.
Abyss Shackles: Enhanced ability to restrain enemies.
Mythical Creature Form: Incomplete Mythical Creature Form.

sequences.name: High Summoner
abilities: Door of Summoning: Can manifest a Door to Summon Spirit World creatures.
Summoning: Partial authority over Summoning; can utilize Moon's influence to Summon various creatures.
Bat Wing Isolation: Can manifest giant Bat Wings to enclose areas in unnatural Darkness.
Full Moon: Can make a Crimson Full Moon ascend with Nourishing effects.
Physical Enhancement: Enhanced sense of smell to pinpoint blood from far away.
Mythical Creature Form: Can respond to prayers.

sequences.name: Life-Giver
abilities: Life: Authority of Life; can treat without medicines, regrow bones and flesh, and calm emotions.
Spirituality: Partial authority over Spirituality; can interfere with and affect Spirituality of targets.
Moonlight Transformation: Can transform into condensed Moonlight even without Moonlit areas.
Door of Summoning: Can open multiple Doors of Summoning under Moonlight.
Bat Wings: Can unfurl giant membranous Bat Wings capable of blotting out the sky.
Full Moon: Can cause Crimson Moonlight to fall from unknown places.
Mythical Creature Form: Complete humanoid with phantom Moon, bright red eyes, and bat wings.

sequences.name: Beauty Goddess
abilities: Gender Transition: Advancing results in becoming female.
Beauty: Lower expression of Beauty authority; overwhelming and transcendent Beauty.
Plants, Animals, Humans, & Supernatural Creatures: Can Tame and Command such creatures.
Moon: Certain degree of Moon's concept; can draw upon power of the Moon.
Moonlight Transformation: Can dissolve into Crimson Light and merge with Moonlight.

sequences.name: Moon
sequences.description: The Moon (which includes the imagery of Fertility and Proliferation) represents Spirituality, Plants, Beauty, Summoning, Animals, Humans, Beyonder Creatures, and portions of Life, Darkness, and Bizarreness.
abilities: Summoning: The Call of the Moon can attract very terrifying things.
Beauty: Authority of Beauty; the second most Beautiful thing in the universe.
Life: Partial authority over Life; can create or alter Living beings.
Plants, Animals, Humans, & Supernatural Creatures: Can Tame Plants, Animals, Humans, and Supernatural Creatures.
Spirituality: Can make Spirituality unable to recover or cause it to erupt.
Darkness: Partial authority over Darkness.
Bizarreness: Partial authority over Bizarreness.
